units.source_text: 源氏内大臣并不知道明石道人有这打算，只是想不通明石姬为何不肯入京。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, did not know that the Akashi monk had such a plan; he only could not understand why the Akashi Lady refused to come to the capital.

units.source_text: 又念让小女公子孤苦伶仃地在乡下长大起来，深恐后世之人议论纷纷，成了她一生的瑕疵。

en.t: He also thought that if the little young lady were left to grow up lonely in the countryside, people in later years would surely gossip about it, and it would become a blemish on her whole life.

units.source_text: 大堰邸宅修理完竣以后，明石道人把发现此屋后的经过情况报告源氏内大臣，

en.t: After the residence at Oi had been repaired, the Akashi monk reported to Genji, the Inner Minister, how he had come to find this house,

units.source_text: 这时他才恍然大悟：明石姬以前一直不肯迁到东院来和众人同居，

en.t: and only then did Genji suddenly understand: the reason the Akashi Lady had long refused to move to the East Wing and live together with the others
was that she had had this plan in mind all along.

units.source_text: 他觉得这件事用心周到，很有意思，心中十分喜慰。

en.t: He felt that the matter had been thoughtfully and carefully arranged, found it very pleasing, and was deeply glad at heart.

units.source_text: 那个惟光朝臣，一向是所有秘密行径的照料都少他不得的人。

en.t: That Koremitsu, the courtier, had always been the indispensable man for attending to all secret undertakings.

units.source_text: 这回也就派他到大堰河去，命令他用心办理邸内各处应有的设备。

en.t: This time as well, Genji sent him to the Oi River and ordered him to take careful charge of all the necessary arrangements throughout the residence.

units.source_text: 惟光回来报道：“那地方风景甚好，与明石浦海边相似。”

en.t: Koremitsu returned and reported, "The scenery there is very fine, and it resembles the seaside at Akashi Bay."

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣想：这样的地方，给这个人住倒很相宜。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, thought that a place like this would be quite suitable for that person to live in.

units.source_text: 源氏公子所建造的佛堂，位在嵯峨大觉寺之南，面对瀑布，风趣之雅，不亚于大觉寺。

en.t: The Buddhist hall that Prince Genji had built stood south of Daikakuji in Saga, facing a waterfall, and its elegant charm was no less than that of Daikakuji itself.

units.source_text: 大堰的明石邸则面临河流，建造在一所美妙不可言喻的松林中。

en.t: The Akashi residence at Oi, by contrast, faced the river and was built amid a pine grove of indescribable beauty.

units.source_text: 其正殿简单朴素，却另有山乡风味。

en.t: Its main hall was simple and unadorned, yet it had a special rustic charm of its own.

units.source_text: 内部装饰布置，均由源氏内大臣设计。

en.t: The interior decorations and furnishings were all designed by Genji, the Inner Minister.
